build_retry_only: specific compiler error or warning; no parameter/library/optimization scan
cpu_retry_only: one concrete failing contract repair; shared total budget
conditional_nsys: Only if CUPTI control/params/activity/output valid, no drops/overflow/errors, and representative internal memset/kernel family reproduced. Distinct process IDs/correlation IDs never joined across captures.
stop_conditions: subscription/callback missing, output mismatch, dropped/overflow, ownership or environment error
fixed workload does not reproduce internal memset path: NOT_REPRODUCED; no shape sweep
nsys lifecycle/export failure: keep raw, no retry
budget expires: keep incomplete evidence, no automatic sampling extension
warning_handling: Preserve actual warnings. Local mechanism diagnosis does not waive model completeness gate or retrospectively explain old6381.
specific_tool_fix: immutable early NVLOG prefix receipt distinct from final daemon log; original auditFAIL unchanged
identity_freeze: Before tests and GPU, hash actual selected source/probe/binary/libs/pinnedtool plus existing parentmanifest; no model changes.
